title: Change Iatreion reporting
summary: Change Iatreion schemas, inventory projection, bounded probes, joins, classification, rendering, packaging, or contracts while preserving source authority and read-only effects.
use_when: Iatreion behavior, integration, packaging, or documentation should change.
do_not_use_when: Only a report or installation operation is needed.
outcome: A tested Iatreion change whose code and complete source contracts agree.
effects: Changes source, tests, documentation, packaging, or declarations. Development does not install or operate products.
authority: Iatreion owns its schema, validation, collection, derived classification, and presentation. Source products own observed facts.
success: Focused tests and the default root CI pass; contract and behavior remain aligned.
failure_and_recovery: Correct the source change and rerun the default CI. Do not deploy partial incompatible schema changes.
privacy: Tests use synthetic operational metadata and do not retain private product content.
steps: Query applicable Semantics repositories and read affected contracts.
Change the smallest owning modules and tests.
checkpoints: Product authority and read-only probe effects remain explicit.
adaptation: Version incompatible status or report meanings instead of silently reinterpreting retained or installed outputs.
stop_when: A proposed probe requires mutation, secrets, network access, or unsupported direct database access.
does_not_authorize: Release, installation, deployment, service operation, or semantic state changes.

consumers.statement: Contributors may change Iatreion and its source integration.

preconditions.statement: Applicable Cell and product contracts and terminology have been read.

inputs.statement: Iatreion source, tests, product declarations, provider-owned probe contracts, documentation, and packaging.

outputs.statement: A source change validated by the selected product and root gates.

data_semantics.statement: Changes preserve the distinction between source observations and Iatreion-derived presentation.

identity_and_units.statement: Product, unit, provider, schema, release, and capability identities remain distinct.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Tests cover affected supported behavior. CI scope follows the repository selector.

access.statement: Development uses the local source checkout and synthetic fixtures.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Publication, installation, and product operation remain separate effects.

operational_limits.statement: Iatreion remains a stateless bounded reporter rather than a monitoring or repair service.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Incompatible status, report, or capability meaning requires a version change and affected consumer update.

reliances.statement: Operational declaration changes reuse Usher's data-only descriptor reader without changing recognition meaning.
